Company background: Copper Sky builds an on-site conversational product discovery widget for DTC brands. Small engineering org focused on fast time-to-market and low latency on product pages.

Inbound story: Self-serve signup -> quick POC attempt using Redwood hosted API. Initially liked pricing and model catalog. Hit friction when wiring LangChain/LlamaIndex flows and trying to host on Vercel Edge.

Technical ask (verbatim paraphrases):
- "Can you show a Node/Typescript LangChain quickstart that uses Redwood hosted API tokens and supports streaming to the browser?"
- "We need a LlamaIndex example that indexes product JSON in S3 and shows retrieval+RAG flow with short latency."
- "How do we wire Vercel AI SDK edge functions to Redwood and keep tokens safe while streaming? CORS issues in dev."

Requirements summary (engineer notes):
- Workloads: chat widget (conversational product finder), embeddings for product search, light reranking for facets.
- Latency/throughput targets: p95 chat < 300ms on simple queries; peak throughput modest (20-50 concurrent chats during peak).
- Cost sensitivity: high — want aggressive batching/caching suggestions and lower-cost model fallbacks.
- Model preferences: open / Llama-family quantized models for cost (prefer 7B/13B quantized variants); want Redwood-verified perf profiles.
- Routing/fallback: automatic fallback to smaller quantized model when load > threshold; prefer policy that preserves prompt context.
- Security/compliance: SOC2 compliance and audit logs required for vendor selection; SSO expected later but not blocker now.

POC plan: 2-week engineering PoC. Day 0-2: quickstart + example repo. Day 3-7: index product catalog (S3) via LlamaIndex; integrate retriever in LangChain chat flow. Day 8-14: deploy to Vercel Edge (streaming), run load test, measure p95.

Links / artifacts: GitHub sandbox repo stub: github.com/coppersky/redwood-quickstart (private). Pricing and security docs linked in Drive. Support ticket SUP-4521 tracking LangChain streaming bug.

Quotes / personality: CEO on call: "We need something our front-end devs can drop in this week — docs + tiny sample app." Engineer: "Streaming to edge is the sticking point; we can index products easily once we can stream responses."
